title: Deterministic Fuzzy Triage for Legal Compliance Classification and Evidence Retrieval
why_relevant: Proposes a deterministic dual-encoder with fuzzy triage bands for legal compliance, touching on abstention/coverage-error tradeoffs.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific legal classification/retrieval system, not about robust RAG under unreliable evidence; abstention mechanism is generic and not focused on noisy/conflicting/adversarial contexts.
